    Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. Intelligently detects scanned vs text-based PDFs to enable smart routing decisions.

    CLI and Agent Skill for Firecrawl - Add scrape, search, and browsing capabilities to your AI agents

    A single-binary Go web dashboard that collects and stores system metrics in bbolt and serves a real-time JSON API and static HTML dashboard (Tailwind, Vanillajs & Chart.js) with zero external dependencies.

    Lightweight macOS menubar calendar with event indicators and one-click meeting join

Hi, I'm Abimael Martell 🇲🇽

Member of Technical Staff at @firecrawl 🔥 (YC S22), building production AI and web-data infrastructure across crawling, document intelligence, evaluation systems, model inference, APIs, and developer tooling.

I have 13+ years of experience building and scaling products at early-stage startups. I enjoy taking ambiguous technical problems from prototype to reliable production systems.

Currently working with TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python, Kubernetes, and GPU inference infrastructure.

🔥 Firecrawl

I contribute extensively across Firecrawl's open-source ecosystem, including its core platform, CLI, and document-processing infrastructure.

  • firecrawl — The web data API for AI agents
  • pdf-inspector — High-performance PDF classification and structured extraction in Rust, with Python and Node.js bindings
  • cli — Search, scrape, crawl, interact with, and extract web data from the terminal
  • html-to-markdown — Fast HTML-to-Markdown conversion

🛠 Projects

  • catchhook — Webhook testing tool built in Rust
  • calendario — Native macOS menu-bar calendar built with Swift
  • claude-clean — Cleaner console output for Claude Code

🌎 Community

I enjoy working directly with developers through open source, technical demos, hackathons, and community events across Mexico and Latin America.

🕰️ Historical projects (from Higher School Preparatory Class)

WARNING: These old projects are written mostly in french language.

  • DES-Crypto-CaML – In 🇫🇷 language
    Copyright © 2008 Hermès Bélusca-Maïto and Guillaume Frèche, Lycée Pierre De Fermat.
    An implementation of the DES cryptographic algorithm, written in the CaML language, with an interactive GUI demonstration that allows choosing what to encrypt/decrypt, as well as choosing different parameters. This was made as part of a mathematics/computer programming project.

  • CamlCAS – 🇬🇧 and 🇫🇷 languages
    Copyright © 2008 - 2009 Hermès Bélusca-Maïto, Lycée Pierre De Fermat.
    A simplistic computer-algebra system (CAS), written in the CaML language. Its main purpose is to perform symbolic integration of multivariate rational functions over the reals or complex fields, with the Risch algorithm:

    • Square-free factorization, using either the Yun or the Tobey-Horowitz (see e.g. arXiv:1306.4342) algorithms;
    • Partial fraction decomposition;
    • Hermite reduction for the rational part;
    • Rothstein-Trager method for the logarithmic part.

    More references:

    • "Symbolic-Numeric Integration of Rational Functions", R.M. Corless, R.H.C. Moir, M.M. Maza, N. Xie (arXiv:1712.01752).
    • Integration of Rational Functions, K.O. Geddes, S.R. Czapor, G. Labahn.
    • More general information on symbolic integration can be found e.g. here.
